name: daily
description: Date-organized daily notes via Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin + Calendar; ports accuris's Timestamps pattern under spice/daily/. v0.1.4: contributes Today nav-button (invoke_command -> daily-notes; the core daily-notes plugin's 'Open today's daily note' command id) requiring nav-buttons >=2.3.0; filename pattern dddd-YYYY-MM-DD per v0.4.2 platform invariant. v0.2.0: SpaceDailyDashboard panels (tasks + meetings) migrated to BeaconCards via panel-host wrapper preserved + per-panel dv shim ({container: subContainerEl}); tasks panel rendered ABOVE meetings panel (S2 user feedback); tasks use synthetic-page pattern with onClick to parent file. v0.2.2: adds autorun:true on app start + Cmd+[ binding for the daily-notes command (consumes new hotkeys[] manifest field shipped with convenience@0.1.0 mechanism in v0.21.1). v0.2.5 PATCH: ships hidden <!-- COWORK_CALLOUTS --> anchor above ## Notes for cowork@0.1.0 callout insertion. v0.2.6 PATCH (v0.31.0 S6.6 — daily dashboard polish): SpaceDailyDashboard meeting filter widened startsWith(today) → includes(today) so trailing-date naming Foo-2026-05-12.md is matched (accuris convention); dashboard container gains box-sizing/width/max-width/overflow-x: hidden so narrow viewports no longer scroll horizontally; task list items gain word-break + overflow-wrap so long no-space task strings wrap. v0.3.0 MINOR (v0.33.0 wave 2): adopts claude_surface[] — ships canonical /daily slash command + open-today SKILL.md + resolvers row. v0.5.0 MINOR (v0.64.0): reclaims canonical ownership of ranch/templates/Daily Note.md (cowork@0.9.1 dropped its competing copy). daily-template.md absorbs Templater preamble + cowork-flavor frontmatter (type/day/day_label/created_at/tags) + H1 + COWORK_CALLOUTS marker. SpaceDailyDashboard grows third 'Today's Activity' panel that delegates to customJS.ActivityFeed.render with new asOf + includeMtime opts (anchors time window to the daily note's date; catches edited-not-just-created notes via file.mtime). Activity panel excludes daily/cowork-daily/cowork-weekly/cowork-monthly types to avoid self-reference. Existing tasks + meetings panels unchanged. v0.5.1 PATCH (v0.64.1): three fixes from headspace smoke. (1) BUGFIX SpaceDailyDashboard activity-panel shim now delegates `.pages` to the real dv — v0.5.0 shim only had `.container`, so ActivityFeed._query's `dv.pages()` call failed with 'dv.pages is not a function' and the panel never rendered. (2) Tasks panel: render markdown links `[text](url)` + wikilinks `[[target]]` (and `[[target|alias]]`) as clickable HTML anchors via new `_renderTaskHTML(text)` helper; LI click still opens parent daily note for clicks outside any anchor; wikilink anchors wire onclick → app.workspace.openLinkText. (3) COWORK_CALLOUTS anchor switched from HTML-comment `<!-- COWORK_CALLOUTS -->` to Obsidian `%% COWORK_CALLOUTS %%` syntax — invisible in BOTH source AND reading mode (HTML comments are only invisible in reading mode). Cowork orchestrator skills + content files + manifest descriptions updated in lockstep (cowork@0.9.1 → 0.9.2 PATCH). v0.5.2 PATCH (v0.64.2): three polish fixes. (1) Activity-panel allowlist drops `scratch-day` + `to-do` — both are per-day auto-created notes that flood the panel with predictable noise. (2) Smart title resolver `_resolveTitle(p)` tries `title:` frontmatter → `aliases[0]` → first heading in `file.outline` → filename fallback. Surfaces user-meaningful titles for timestamp-named scratches once user adds `title:` or `aliases:`. (3) Visual polish: each of the 3 main sections (Tasks / Meetings / Activity) wrapped in `<details>` with colored left border + count in summary; default open. Activity sub-groups (one per blueprint type) wrapped in `<details>` via ActivityFeed's new `collapsible` + `colorByType` opts; default closed. Per-blueprint accent colors from Obsidian `--color-*` CSS variables (themable). depends_on bumped activity-feed >=0.1.1 → >=0.1.2. v0.5.3 PATCH (v0.64.3): two fixes from v0.64.2 headspace smoke. (1) BUGFIX `_resolveTitle` was crashing with `aliases.values is not a function` when scratch / meeting notes had no `aliases:` frontmatter — Dataview's `p.file.aliases` is a Proxy/DataArray where `.values` is a non-callable property (not Array.prototype.values). The throw aborted BeaconCards mid-render, leaving activity-panel cards visually empty. Wrapped resolver in try-catch + simplified aliases probe to length-only (any throw falls back to filename). (2) Allowlist drops `meeting` — already has its own dedicated top-level 'Today's Meetings' panel; duplicate inside Activity was noise. Allowlist now: scratch, journal, project, person, team, product, trip, budget, paycheck, invoice. v0.6.0 MINOR (v0.65.0 cowork-scheduling-cycle): SpaceDailyDashboard _DEFAULT_DASHBOARD_BLUEPRINTS allowlist widens to include 6 cowork run-note types (cowork-morning-briefing/midday-tripwire/eod-review/finance-snapshot/weekly-review/monthly-review). Scheduled-job atomic notes now surface in "Today's Activity" under their own blueprint groups (groupBy:"blueprint" already on). No new section; no new icon. v0.7.0 MINOR (v0.66.0): Activity Dashboard Cohesion cycle. SpaceDailyDashboard sections (Tasks/Meetings/Activity) render via _renderSection helper backed by NEW sauce-daily-dashboard.css snippet (chevron-right rotates on [open], muted-uppercase group headers replace nested <details>, mobile pass at @media max-width:480px). Activity panel consumes activity-feed@0.3.0 opts: rollUpRoots (project + trip descendant edits coalesce into a single hub card — closes FLN-v64-8), flatGrouped (one-tap reveal at outer section), metaBuilder ([page,parentEl]=>void wires per-card time + type pill + breadcrumb meta via cards@0.2.6 function-form meta). depends_on activity-feed bumped >=0.1.2 → >=0.3.0; new snippets[] + appearance.enabledCssSnippets[] manifest fields installed via convenience@0.41.0 applySnippets plumbing. v0.7.1 PATCH (v0.66.1): three smoke fixes. (1) Section titles drop "Today's" prefix — "Tasks"/"Meetings"/"Activity" (the daily-note context already implies today). (2) Activity section defaults to closed (was open) — the review-y panel is now opt-in; Tasks + Meetings stay default-open since they're actionable. (3) _resolveTitle gains a frontmatter `name:` check BEFORE the existing title/aliases/outline/filename chain — project hubs at <slug>/Project.md were resolving to the literal filename "Project"; the project blueprint stores the real name in `name:`. depends_on activity-feed bumped >=0.3.0 → >=0.3.1 (synthetic rollup page now carries the name field). v0.8.0 MINOR (v0.67.0): Activity Drill-In + Polish. _renderActivityMeta rewritten with Luxon duck-type time fix (FLN-v66-7 — closes every-card 12:00 AM regression), inline drill-in expansion for rollup cards (click \"N notes touched\" → list of children with HH:MM, sorted by file.mtime DESC, capped at 12 + \"+N more\"), universal open-todo badge (\"☐ N\" pill) wired into Meetings panel via BeaconCards meta function-form and Activity meta-line. Activity section icon swapped zap → activity (Lucide heartbeat). Activity section default-open (existing if activityCount > 0 gate handles non-empty). Segmented per-blueprint left accent on Activity section — CSS custom property \"--sauce-accent-segments\" rendered via ::before pseudo-element; Tasks/Meetings unchanged (single-color border-left). Four new helpers: _formatTime (Luxon duck-type), _renderTodoBadge, _renderDrillInList, _buildAccentSegments. _renderSection accepts new optional accentSegments param. _getActivityCount returns {total, byBlueprint} for segment sizing. CSS additions (~50 lines) in sauce-daily-dashboard.css. depends_on activity-feed bumped to >=0.3.2 (consumes _rollUpChildrenPages). v0.8.1 PATCH (v0.67.1): four fixes from user smoke. (1) Drill-in `[hidden]` collapse — CSS `display: flex` was clobbering the [hidden] attribute's UA `display: none`; moved display rule into `:not([hidden])` selector. (2) Drill-in DOM placement — drill-in `<div>` now appended to the CARD root (walking parentEl.parentElement.parentElement) instead of the meta row, so it spans full card width below the title/meta row instead of squeezing the title into ellipsis on desktop. (3) Section icon vertical alignment — `.sauce-section-icon` gets `display: inline-flex; align-items: center` + inner `svg { display: block }` to remove the inline baseline gap. (4) `_getActivityCount` now mirrors ActivityFeed's rollup logic — synthetic rollup roots are counted (and project descendant counts roll up to the project blueprint) so the segmented accent reflects the cards that actually render, not just direct-hit allowlist matches. byBlueprint bucketing maps project-* / trip-* to their parent blueprint for consistent color resolution. v0.8.2 PATCH (v0.67.2): two fixes from user smoke. (1) Segmented accent ordering — `_buildAccentSegments` now sorts byBlueprint entries alphabetically so segments render top-down in the same order ActivityFeed groups (project before scratch, etc.). Pre-v0.8.2 the iteration mixed direct-hits (scratches first) before rollup roots (project second), producing inverted accent vs. visual content. (2) COWORK_CALLOUTS marker syntax changed from Obsidian `%% COWORK_CALLOUTS %%` to standard markdown link-ref `[//]: # (COWORK_CALLOUTS)`. The `%% %%` syntax was visible in source mode AND in live-preview when cursor parked on the line — users saw the marker text in their daily notes. `[//]: # (...)` is invisible in BOTH Reading mode AND Live Preview (only visible in Source mode), matching the original intent. Daily template + commands/daily.md doc updated; cowork blueprint 0.10.0 → 0.10.1 PATCH ships matching syntax in Weekly/Monthly Note + About Cowork + 5 orchestrator/skill SKILL.md files. Behavior contract unchanged — cowork orchestrators still locate the anchor by literal string match, just against the new syntax. v0.8.3 PATCH (v0.67.3): user-feedback simplification of daily template + retire segmented accent. (1) Daily template — removed the COWORK_CALLOUTS anchor (both `[//]: # (...)` form from v0.8.2 and any prior `%% %%` form remained user-visible in Live Preview); removed the `## Notes` heading; appended a `---` horizontal-rule divider after the dashboard dataviewjs block as the visual separator between platform-rendered content and the user's free-write space. Cowork orchestrators that previously located the marker now fall through `patch-daily-callouts/SKILL.md`'s absent-marker-and-no-Notes-heading branch (append at EOF). (2) Activity section accent — retired the v0.8.0 segmented per-blueprint gradient. Activity now uses single-color `accent: "grey"` (new CSS rule `[data-accent="grey"] { border-left: 4px solid var(--text-faint) }`), matching the user's preference for a subtle grey throughout. `_buildAccentSegments` retained as dead code (HC-V067-1d still asserts it exists); future cycle may remove if not re-used. DD-T1 test regex updated: drops COWORK_CALLOUTS positive-assert + adds COWORK_CALLOUTS-absent + `## Notes`-absent negative-asserts. v0.9.0 MINOR (sauce v0.69.0): SpaceDailyDashboard Activity panel now surfaces board activity (spice/boards/To-Do-Board.md hub edits + new board-card creations under spice/boards/cards/**). Three changes in the helper: allowlist gains kanban + board-card; blueprint color map gains kanban: var(--color-pink); rollup rules gain a single-board entry with hardcoded rootPathFromDv -> spice/boards/To-Do-Board.md (constant, unlike the slug-derived project/trip rules). One rolled-up 'To Do Board' card per day; drill-in lists today's touched card files. Title resolves via the existing title-resolver branch from the hub's `title: To Do Board` frontmatter. No new helpers; no CSS changes; no manifest depends_on changes (boards blueprint emits the `type: board-card` and `type: kanban` frontmatter directly). v0.10.0 MINOR (sauce v0.70.0): Activity Cohesion cycle. SpaceDailyDashboard activity panel switches to activity-feed@0.4.0 framed renderer. Three behavioral changes from a user-facing perspective: (1) cowork-* sub-types collapse into a single 'Cowork' group via bucketRules; (2) hybrid ordering — Cowork → Project → Kanban → Trip pinned at the top in that order, alphabetical middle, Scratch pinned at the bottom and collapsed by default via defaultClosed:['scratch']; (3) each sub-group renders as a framed section (bg + left-accent stripe + flat list rows, no per-row card rectangles). _BLUEPRINT_COLORS gains cowork: var(--color-blue) for the new bucket. Retired: _buildAccentSegments helper (v0.8.0 dead code per v0.8.3) + _renderSection's accentSegments param + the unused activityByBlueprint local in render(). CSS: new .sauce-group* rule block in sauce-daily-dashboard.css; removed v0.7.0 'Inner group headers' (flatGrouped) block + v0.8.0 '[data-segmented]::before' block. depends_on activity-feed bumped >=0.3.2 → >=0.4.0. v0.10.1 PATCH (sauce v0.70.1): alignment + mobile-stack polish in sauce-daily-dashboard.css. (1) Desktop time anchor: `.sauce-group-row-meta > time` gets min-width: 56px + text-align: right + font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so times line up vertically across rows in the same group. (2) Desktop breathing room: row-line padding 8/14 → 10/16; meta gap 6/10 → 8/14; meta cluster justify-content: flex-end. (3) Mobile (≤480px) stack: row-line goes flex-direction: column, title gets width: 100% + white-space: normal (wraps instead of ellipsis), meta wraps below the title — fixes the pre-patch failure where wide-meta rows (e.g., kanban 'To Do Board' with breadcrumb) collapsed title to width:0. CSS-only change; no helper changes; no manifest depends_on changes. v0.10.2 PATCH (sauce v0.70.2): visual refinement on the v0.10.0 framed-group rendering. (1) Inner sub-group accent moves from a 4px LEFT-only stripe to a 1px FULL-wrap border in the accent color — wraps all four sides for visual cohesion. (2) Vertical spacing unified under a new --sauce-section-gap CSS custom property (default 12px on desktop, 8px on mobile via @media override). .sauce-group margin: var(--sauce-section-gap) 0 — gives consistent breathing room between sibling groups AND between the outer section header and the first inner group (matching the Meetings → meeting-card spacing pattern). CSS-only; no helper changes; no manifest depends_on changes. v0.10.3 PATCH (sauce v0.70.3): unified visual language across the dashboard. (1) Outer sections (Tasks/Meetings/Activity) adopt the same 1px full-wrap accent border as the inner .sauce-group, replacing the 4px left-stripe variants on all four [data-accent] selectors (cyan/blue/purple/grey). Section margin-bottom moves to var(--sauce-section-gap) for consistent vertical spacing with inner groups. (2) NEW empty-state panel — when the day has no tasks, meetings, or activity, the helper now renders a polished .sauce-empty-state div ('No activity recorded yet' with the activity icon, dashed border, muted italic text) instead of the prior silent early-return. CSS-only outside the helper's one new render branch; no manifest depends_on changes. v0.10.4 PATCH (sauce v0.70.4): 'Quiet Frames' visual treatment. Accent color migrates OFF the .sauce-section + .sauce-group borders and ONTO (a) the section icon via a new --section-accent custom property bound from each [data-accent] selector and (b) the inner .sauce-group-dot, which already carries --group-accent via inline style. Frames are now uniformly neutral 1px var(--background-modifier-border). Background-radius on .sauce-section bumped 6 → 8px for a softer feel. Goal: let neutrals handle structure, color become punctuation. CSS-only; no helper changes; no manifest depends_on changes. v0.10.5 PATCH (sauce v0.70.5): meeting cards on the daily-dashboard Meetings panel now surface (a) the attendee list as the subtitle (preferring frontmatter `attendees:` over a body `## Attendees` section; comma-separated with `+N` overflow above 3 names; bare display names stripped from `[[wikilink]]` form), (b) an open-tasks pill (e.g. `1 open`) when the body has `- [ ]` checkbox tokens, (c) a `Notes` pill when the body has substantive notes content (`## Notes` heading OR body prose >20 non-whitespace chars). Pills use `style: outline` with `tone: warn` (open tasks, soft amber) and `tone: accent` (notes), calibrated for the Quiet Frames aesthetic. NEW async helper `_enrichMeeting(p)` on SpaceDailyDashboard reads each meeting file via `app.vault.read` once per render. Mirrors the meetings-hub enrichment pattern but rendered with subtler tones. No new mechanism depends_on; cards 0.2.6 already supports `badges[]` + outline style. v0.10.6 PATCH (sauce v0.70.6): BUGFIX — Obsidian Mobile occasionally returns a stale `dv.current()` (the previously-focused leaf's file rather than the embedding note) when the user navigates quickly between daily notes; the dashboard's `today` resolver was reading the wrong filename and rendering yesterday's activity into today's daily. NEW helper `_resolveCurrentFileName(dv)` walks `app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('markdown')` and picks the leaf whose `view.contentEl.contains(dv.container)` — the embedding leaf is authoritative regardless of focus state. Falls back to `dv.current().file.name` when the leaf walk fails (e.g., unit-test shims). Symptom that triggered the fix: headspace mobile rendered Wednesday's 7 activities (3 cowork + 4 scratch) into Thursday's daily. v0.10.7 PATCH (sauce v0.70.7): BUGFIX — mirror activity-feed@0.4.1's strict created_at semantics in `_getActivityCount`. When a page has a `created_at` field, the in-window check is purely created_at-based; we no longer fall through to file.mtime when created_at is out-of-window. mtime is consulted only for legacy pages without created_at. Same root cause as activity-feed@0.4.1: Obsidian Mobile re-touches files at sync time, so mtime is unreliable; created_at is the authoritative 'created today' signal. depends_on activity-feed bumped >=0.4.0 → >=0.4.1. v0.11.0 MINOR (sauce v0.71.0 cowork-presentation-polish): SpaceDailyDashboard consumes activity-feed@0.5.0's two new opts. getSubtitle surfaces frontmatter.summary on cowork-* atomic notes; non-cowork pages preserve existing behavior. groupPreviewBuilder returns the most-recent page's summary for defaultClosed groups — fires only on scratch (the currently-pinned-collapsed group). _renderActivityMeta grows a minimal cowork-aware block appending a .sauce-meta-subtitle span with the curated summary on cowork-* rows. _BLUEPRINT_PILL_COLORS refactored from alias-to-_BLUEPRINT_COLORS to a spread+extend pattern adding 6 cowork-* sub-type entries (morning=blue, midday=yellow, eod=purple, finance=cyan, weekly=pink, monthly=red). Closes two v0.70.0 carry-forwards: 'one-line preview for collapsed groups' + 'color individual cowork-* sub-type pills'. depends_on activity-feed bumped >=0.4.1 → >=0.5.0. v0.12.0 MINOR (sauce v0.72.0): kanban progress surfacing. SpaceDailyDashboard invokes customJS.KanbanStatusSync.syncAllBoards(dv, today) BEFORE customJS.ActivityFeed.render, so kanban cards moved today get status + status_prev + status_changed_at written and surface in the same render. ActivityFeed.render call gains tsKeys: ['created_at', 'status_changed_at'] (consumes activity-feed@0.6.0). New helper _renderKanbanDrillInList renders per-card transition lines (move: From → To; create: — created in Column; archive: archived) inside kanban rollups; non-kanban rollups fall through to the existing _renderDrillInList. Precedence on same-day multi-state: archive > move > create. depends_on activity-feed bumped >=0.5.1 → >=0.6.0; new dependency kanban-status-sync >=0.1.0. v0.13.0 MINOR (sauce v0.73.0): Part A — removed inline customJS.KanbanStatusSync.syncAllBoards call from SpaceDailyDashboard.render; the sync now runs once per session via the NEW KanbanStatusSyncInit customjs startup-script (kanban-status-sync@0.2.0). Dashboard reads pre-synced frontmatter, never triggers the sync inline — removes our code from every Dataview re-execution. Part B — _renderSection accepts stateKey + sectionState; persists <details> open/closed state per-section to ranch/cache/dashboard-section-state.json (sauce-daily-dashboard:tasks / :meetings / :activity). _readSectionState + _writeSectionStateKey helpers added. Toggle event writes back; best-effort (missing file or malformed JSON falls back to defaultOpen). Manual cache-bypass available via Cmd+P → 'Sauce: Re-sync kanban boards'. depends_on activity-feed bumped >=0.6.0 → >=0.7.0; kanban-status-sync bumped >=0.1.0 → >=0.2.0. v0.13.5 PATCH (sauce v0.89.1): SpaceDailyDashboard._resolveTitle typed-alias guard for people@0.6.0 {type, value} alias shape; defensive [object Object] fallthrough catches any other object-leak (Dataview Link wrappers etc.). Bare-string alias back-compat preserved. Fix: newly-created person notes no longer render as the literal string "[object Object]" in the daily-activity panel.

post_install.message: Daily blueprint installed at spice/daily/. REQUIRED: enable the core Daily Notes plugin (Settings → Core plugins → Daily notes) AND optionally the Calendar community plugin (Settings → Community plugins → Browse → Calendar). Run command 'Daily notes: Open today's daily note' (or click a date in Calendar) to create your first daily note.
